_source.title: 通用样式属性：可被布局容器等组件继承的样式集合
_source.properties.backgroundColor: 背景颜色，接受任意 CSS 颜色值
_source.properties.borderWidth: 边框宽度（像素），>0 时生效
_source.properties.borderColor: 边框颜色，仅在 borderWidth > 0 时生效
_source.properties.hide: 是否隐藏（display: none），优先于 invisible
_source.properties.color: 文本颜色，接受任意 CSS 颜色值
_source.properties.padding: 内边距（CSS 简写），如 [上,右,下,左] 或 [上下,左右] 或 [全部]
_source.properties.margin: 外边距（CSS 简写），如 [上,右,下,左] 或 [上下,左右] 或 [全部]
_source.properties.cursor: 鼠标悬停时的光标样式
_source.properties.invisible: 是否仅隐藏视觉（visibility: hidden），仍占位

title: Common style properties: a style set that can be inherited by components such as layout containers
properties.backgroundColor: Background color. Accepts any CSS color value
properties.borderColor: Border color. Only takes effect when borderWidth > 0
properties.hide: Whether to hide (display: none), taking precedence over invisible
properties.color: Text color. Accepts any CSS color value
properties.padding: Padding (CSS shorthand), e.g. [top, right, bottom, left] or [vertical, horizontal] or [all]
properties.margin: Margin (CSS shorthand), e.g. [top, right, bottom, left] or [vertical, horizontal] or [all]
properties.cursor: Cursor style when the mouse hovers
properties.invisible: Whether to only hide visually (visibility: hidden), still occupying space
